name: tr-company-formation
description: How to form a company in Turkey (Türkiye) in 2026, step by step, from the Turkish Commercial Code No. 6102, the Fees Law No. 492 and the Competition Law No. 4054. Covers the limited company (limited şirket) and the joint stock company (anonim şirket), the minimum capital of TRY 50,000 and TRY 250,000 (TRY 500,000 initial capital for a non-public registered-capital joint stock company), the 25% payment before registration for a joint stock company, the blocked bank account, signing and registering through MERSIS and the trade registry, the 2026 registry fees, the 0.04% Competition Authority share, tax registration through the registry, branches and liaison offices of foreign companies, the first-year compliance calendar, and the deadline for existing companies to raise their capital, now 31 December 2027. Trigger phrases include şirket kuruluşu, limited şirket kurmak, anonim şirket sermayesi, set up a company in Turkey, minimum capital Turkey. Corporate tax, VAT and payroll after format
